context: The skill should write Optional value-reading code that binds the selected value once instead of repeatedly reopening the Optional.

checklist.name: Creates requested planner
checklist.description: Creates CardMovePlanner.java with moveIfNeeded(Optional<ListRef>, Card) and the requested records.

checklist.name: Uses direct value binding
checklist.description: Uses target.map(...).orElse(card), a helper, or another direct shape that binds the ListRef once for value-reading logic.

checklist.name: No repeated Optional reopening
checklist.description: Does not use target.get() or target.orElseThrow() repeatedly after an isPresent()/isEmpty() guard.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves move behavior
checklist.description: Returns the original card when target is absent or already current, and returns a new Card with the target id otherwise.
